Top-down, dry-to-wet

The visit, minute by minute

Dust falls before the mop. Every room has a start time and a list, and every line gets a tick.

Visit clock 0:00 Kitchen

  1. Starts at 0:00

    Kitchen

    • High dust: fan blades and light fixtures
    • Cabinet fronts and backsplash wiped
    • Stovetop grates scrubbed
    • Sink drain cleaned

  2. Starts at 0:50

    Bathrooms

    • Shower glass squeegeed
    • Tub grout line hand-scrubbed
    • Vanity and mirror wiped
    • Floor mopped last

  3. Starts at 1:40

    Bedrooms & living

    • Baseboards wiped edge to edge
    • Sills and blinds dusted
    • Surfaces cleared and reset

  4. Starts at 2:30

    Floors, last

    • Vacuum lines across carpet
    • Hardwood swept then damp-mopped
    • Entry mat shaken out

  5. Finished at 3:10

    Walk-through with you, then the sheet is signed.

March to May: pollen film on a Greenville porch rail. Rails, sills and the porch door get wiped on every spring visit.

The full list

What we clean

Every service runs the same top-down, dry-to-wet method. Each line gets its tick before we leave.

  • Every-other-week cleaning

    The same checklist every visit, top to bottom and dry to wet, so nothing gets skipped.

    Price my visit

  • First deep clean

    A longer first visit for baseboards, grout, blinds and the build-up that regular visits keep away.

    Price my visit

  • Move-out cleaning

    Empty house cleaned inside cabinets, oven and fridge, with photos sent when we lock up.

    Price my visit

  • Move-in cleaning

    Shelves, drawers and closets wiped before your boxes arrive, so you unpack into clean.

    Price my visit

  • Kitchen detail

    Cabinet fronts, backsplash, stovetop grates and the sink drain scrubbed, not just wiped.

    Price my visit

  • Bathroom reset

    Soap scum, hard-water spots and the grout line around the tub worked off by hand.

    Price my visit

  • Spring pollen clean

    Yellow pollen dusted off sills, fans, screens and porch furniture after the April coat.

    Price my visit

  • Inside windows & blinds

    Inside glass, tracks and every blind slat wiped, room by room.

    Price my visit

  • After-renovation dust

    Fine drywall dust vacuumed and wiped off every ledge, vent and cabinet top after the crew leaves.

    Price my visit

  • Sheets & laundry

    Beds stripped and remade with fresh sheets, one load washed and folded while we clean.

    Price my visit
